evidence_slice: University of Exeter Digital Estate Team's public ArcGIS Roof Access Safety Web App describes detailed building-specific roof data for the University's Exeter campuses, uses British National Grid, and includes interactive university rooftop layers across Streatham and St Luke's campuses. The selected no-login item surface did not expose an individual Forum feature geometry, and rooftop geometry was not treated as equivalent to the building's physical ground footprint. No geometry or Forum-specific feature attributes were inferred.

field_evidence.footprint: The public app metadata describes interactive university rooftop layers in British National Grid, but no individual Forum feature geometry was exposed and rooftop geometry was not treated as a physical ground footprint.
field_evidence.type_use: The public app metadata describes building-specific roof data and building categories at application level, but the selected surface exposed no Forum-specific feature attributes binding explicit type/use to geometry.
field_evidence.location: The public app metadata covers the University of Exeter's Streatham and St Luke's campuses.
field_evidence.license: The selected ArcGIS item surface states University reuse/extraction restrictions and licensed authoritative/Ordnance Survey inputs; no OGL grant for this dashboard surface was identified.
